# The V Spot Network
> Cross-Atlantic B2B media on ecommerce, retail, and AI. Written and produced by Vinny O'Brien (Tralee, Ireland / New York). Satirical on the surface, analyst-grade underneath.

## Shows
- [The Ostrich Report](https://thevspotnews.com/shows/ostrich-report/): Long-form editorial essays on ecommerce infrastructure, co-created with Hendrik Laubscher. Home of the EU de minimis series.
- [The Struggle Bus](https://thevspotnews.com/shows/struggle-bus/): Podcast. Deep operator conversations about the unglamorous middle of ecommerce.
- [Nearly News](https://thevspotnews.com/shows/nearly-news/): Weekly satirical ecommerce video news.

## Frameworks
- Friction as Currency: the argument that removing all friction from commerce destroys value.
- THOUGHT/COMMERCIAL grid: governance framework for evaluating media and consulting projects.
- Cross-Atlantic lens: reading EU commerce developments through a North American frame, and vice versa.

## VINLAND
- [The Reformation of Compute](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/reformation-of-compute/): Part 1 of Prisoners of Compute, on open models and interpretive authority.
- [The Compute Tithe](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/compute-tithe/): Part 2, on AI capital expenditure, debt and infrastructure cycles.
- [The Map Beneath the Cloud](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/map-beneath-cloud/): Part 3, on the physical geography beneath AI.
- [Who Owns the Rails?](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/who-owns-the-rails/): Part 4, on transatlantic investment, sovereignty and commerce infrastructure.

## About
- [About Vinny O'Brien](https://thevspotnews.com/about/): 15+ years ecommerce operator (eBay, Arnotts), consultant to $100M+ brands, media founder.

## Work with Vinny
- [Book a call](https://thevspotnews.com/book/): consulting, sponsorship, and speaking enquiries, handled by his fictional agent Murt Moriarty.
- [Be a guest](https://thevspotnews.com/guest/): apply to appear on The Struggle Bus or The Sunday Supplement.
- [Now](https://thevspotnews.com/now/): what Vinny is currently working on, updated monthly.
